name: @ts-defold/hermes
description: TypeScript tooling and Hermes runtime integration for Defold

scripts.bootstrap: npm run bootstrap:upstreams && npm run bootstrap:bob
scripts.check: npm run check:bindings && npm run check:lua-bridge && npm run check:sdk-inventory && npm run check:script-api-inventory && npm run check:script-sdk && npm run check:dmsdk-sdk && npm run check:types && npm run check:knowledge
scripts.build:device-dev: npm run build:js && cmake --build build/native --target hermesc --parallel && build/native/bin/hermesc -Og -g2 -emit-binary -out=dist/sample.hbc dist/sample.js
scripts.build:release-plan: npm run build:js && npm run generate:release-bindings
scripts.build:native: npm run configure:native && cmake --build build/native --target defold-hermes-runner --parallel
scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:native
scripts.bench:lua-bridge: npm run generate:lua-bridge && npm run configure:native && cmake --build build/native --target defold-hermes-lua-bridge-test --parallel && build/native/defold-hermes-lua-bridge-test
scripts.test:device-dev: npm run build:native && npm run build:device-dev && node --test tests/bytecode.test.mjs
scripts.test:lua-hermes: npm run generate:bindings && npm run generate:lua-bridge && npm run configure:native && cmake --build build/native --target defold-hermes-lua-hermes-e2e --parallel && build/native/defold-hermes-lua-hermes-e2e
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:codegen && npm run test:lua-codegen && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:contract && npm run test:web-host && npm run test:web-library && npm run test:cli && npm run test:usage
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run test:native && npm run test:device-dev && npm run test:lua-bridge && npm run test:lua-hermes && npm run check:static-hermes && npm run check:extension-syntax && npm run package:defold
